topic: Heated seats stopped working and it's not always the switch

beats.narration: Heated seats stopped working? It's not always the switch.
beats.visualPrompt: Interior shot, static-mounted camera low across a front seat cushion, cool overcast light through the windshield, subtle breath-fog suggesting cold cabin air.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: One side warms, the other stays cold — or neither side does anymore.
beats.visualPrompt: Split-style cut: close-up on a seat-heater toggle switch icon on a center console, glowing amber (unresponsive), then a wide interior shot of two front seats side by side under even cabin lighting.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Three clues to check in order: the fuse, the switch, then the heating element itself.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a fuse box panel with one visible blown fuse held near the panel (tool/part visible, no hand in frame), slow push-in; cut to a seat cushion partially removed on a workbench with a wiring harness and thermostat module visible.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: A blown fuse can point to a bigger short — one that can keep coming back if it's ignored.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a scorched or discolored wire connector resting on a shop bench, dim shop-bay lighting, static hold, subtle grain to suggest an electrical fault.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Don't guess which one it is before you start pulling seats apart.
beats.visualPrompt: Underbody-style inspection shot repurposed for interior: a multimeter probe positioned near a seat wiring connector (tool visible, mounted/clipped, no hand in frame), shop bay softly blurred behind.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Worth checking before winter gets here. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
